Novoic Storyteller Data

Source: R/data.R
RMT_STORYTELLER.Rd

Novoic Storyteller Data data. More information is available at https://adni.loni.usc.edu/data-samples/adni-data/

Usage

data(RMT_STORYTELLER)

Format

A data frame with 15878 observations and 72 variables.

Source

https://adni.loni.usc.edu/data-samples/adni-data/

Details

  • RMT_PHASE character Phase of the study in which this observation was collected , with options: ADNI4

  • ADNIOnlineID character Participant Identifier for the Remote Cohort

  • PTID character Participant Identifier for the in-clinic ADNI study (if applicable)

  • RMT_Timepoint character Timepoint of observation , with options: m00, m06, m12, m18, m24, m30

  • EXAMDATE Date of examination Date: YYYY-MM-DD

  • SCREENER_SCORE numeric Overall G-match score for the screener Range value: 0, ..., 100

  • SCREENER_RECOMMEND character Overall recommendation for the screener 0=No ; 1=Yes Decoded Value: Yes

  • QC_ATTEMPTS numeric Number of attempts at the quality control task Range value: 1, ..., 11

  • QC_PASSED character Whether the quality control task was passed 0=No ; 1=Yes Decoded Value: Yes

  • USER_AGENT character User agent string

  • STORY1IMM_LANGUAGE character Language for story 1 immediate recall , with options: en-US, es-US

  • STORY1IMM_PLAYBACK_COUNT numeric Audio stimulus playback count for story 1 immediate recall Range value: 0, ..., 5

  • STORY1IMM_AUDIO_LENGTH numeric Participant audio length for story 1 immediate recall Range value: 0.76, ..., 305.18

  • STORY1IMM_NUM_PRONOUNS numeric Number of pronouns for story 1 immediate recall Range value: 0, ..., 77

  • STORY1IMM_NUM_NOUNS numeric Number of nouns for story 1 immediate recall Range value: 0, ..., 46

  • STORY1IMM_NUM_PROPER_NOUNS numeric Number of proper nouns for story 1 immediate recall Range value: 0, ..., 13

  • STORY1IMM_NUM_VERBS numeric Number of verbs for story 1 immediate recall Range value: 0, ..., 56

  • STORY1IMM_NUM_ADVERBS numeric Number of adverbs for story 1 immediate recall Range value: 0, ..., 28

  • STORY1IMM_NUM_ADJECTIVES numeric Number of adjectives for story 1 immediate recall Range value: 0, ..., 18

  • STORY1IMM_NUM_WORDS numeric Number of words for story 1 immediate recall Range value: 0, ..., 350

  • STORY1IMM_IDEA_DENSITY numeric Idea density for story 1 immediate recall Range value: 0, ..., 1

  • STORY1IMM_UNIQUE_WORDS_RATIO numeric Unique words ratio for story 1 immediate recall Range value: 0.357142857142857, ..., 1

  • STORY1IMM_MEAN_LETTER_PER_WORD numeric Mean number of letters per word for story 1 immediate recall Range value: 2, ..., 9

  • STORY1IMM_GMATCH numeric G-match score (source text vs transcript) for story 1 immediate recall Range value: 0, ..., 100

  • STORY1IMM_SPEECH_DURATION numeric Speech duration for story 1 immediate recall Range value: 0, ..., 112.6

  • STORY1IMM_NONSPEECH_PROPORTION numeric Non-speech proportion of time for story 1 immediate recall Range value: 0, ..., 0.912912912912913

  • STORY1IMM_SPEECH_RATE numeric Speech rate for story 1 immediate recall Range value: 0.0338983050847458, ..., 5.55555555555556

  • STORY1IMM_ARTICULATION_RATE numeric Articulation rate for story 1 immediate recall Range value: 0.0338983050847458, ..., 5.55555555555556

  • STORY1IMM_NUM_PAUSES numeric Number of pauses for story 1 immediate recall Range value: 0, ..., 35

  • STORY1IMM_MEAN_PAUSE_LENGTH numeric Mean length of pauses for story 1 immediate recall Range value: 0.3, ..., 39.8

  • STORY2IMM_LANGUAGE character Language for story 2 immediate recall , with options: en-US, es-US

  • STORY2IMM_PLAYBACK_COUNT numeric Audio stimulus playback count for story 2 immediate recall Range value: 0, ..., 5

  • STORY2IMM_AUDIO_LENGTH numeric Participant audio length for story 2 immediate recall Range value: 0.08, ..., 305.52

  • STORY2IMM_NUM_PRONOUNS numeric Number of pronouns for story 2 immediate recall Range value: 0, ..., 62

  • STORY2IMM_NUM_NOUNS numeric Number of nouns for story 2 immediate recall Range value: 0, ..., 70

  • STORY2IMM_NUM_PROPER_NOUNS numeric Number of proper nouns for story 2 immediate recall Range value: 0, ..., 17

  • STORY2IMM_NUM_VERBS numeric Number of verbs for story 2 immediate recall Range value: 0, ..., 69

  • STORY2IMM_NUM_ADVERBS numeric Number of adverbs for story 2 immediate recall Range value: 0, ..., 34

  • STORY2IMM_NUM_ADJECTIVES numeric Number of adjectives for story 2 immediate recall Range value: 0, ..., 22

  • STORY2IMM_NUM_WORDS numeric Number of words for story 2 immediate recall Range value: 0, ..., 363

  • STORY2IMM_IDEA_DENSITY numeric Idea density for story 2 immediate recall Range value: 0, ..., 1

  • STORY2IMM_UNIQUE_WORDS_RATIO numeric Unique words ratio for story 2 immediate recall Range value: 0.235955056179775, ..., 1

  • STORY2IMM_MEAN_LETTER_PER_WORD numeric Mean number of letters per word for story 2 immediate recall Range value: 2, ..., 12

  • STORY2IMM_GMATCH numeric G-match score (source text vs transcript) for story 2 immediate recall Range value: 0, ..., 100

  • STORY2IMM_SPEECH_DURATION numeric Speech duration for story 2 immediate recall Range value: 0, ..., 128.6

  • STORY2IMM_NONSPEECH_PROPORTION numeric Non-speech proportion of time for story 2 immediate recall Range value: 0, ..., 0.898190045248869

  • STORY1DEL_LANGUAGE character Language for story 1 delayed recall , with options: en-US, en, es-US

  • STORY1DEL_NUM_WORDS numeric Number of words for story 1 delayed recall Range value: 0, ..., 668

  • STORY1DEL_IDEA_DENSITY numeric Idea density for story 1 delayed recall Range value: 0, ..., 1

  • STORY1DEL_UNIQUE_WORDS_RATIO numeric Unique words ratio for story 1 delayed recall Range value: 0.366766467065868, ..., 1

  • STORY1DEL_MEAN_LETTER_PER_WORD numeric Mean number of letters per word for story 1 delayed recall Range value: 1, ..., 12

  • STORY1DEL_GMATCH numeric G-match score (source text vs transcript) for story 1 delayed recall Range value: 0, ..., 100
